_about: Operator-declared working assumptions (D11/D12; ticket 15). User-authored, engine-read-only. Each declaration resolves a budget input the deterministic unit-cost deriver could not otherwise find: the deriver reads host_country and project_duration_months ONLY from selected_call.json and this file, whereas SYN-SPINE-01 placed the host (ELTE/HU) in consortium/roles.json and the 24-month duration in the architecture inputs. Declaring here makes those two inputs operator-declared 'Assumed', which gate_09 accepts (CLAUDE.md §8.4). This is the SYN-SPINE-01 demo / engine-integration run (13A); a real finalization run (13B) would carry the confirmed host and duration in selected_call.json as Confirmed facts, not Assumed declarations.

declarations.rationale: Host beneficiary is Eotvos Lorand University (ELTE), Budapest, Hungary (HU) per SYN-SPINE-01 (consortium/roles.json HOST role, country_code HU). The unit-cost deriver reads host_country from selected_call.json / working_assumptions.json only (not roles.json), so the synthetic host country is declared here to resolve the living-allowance country-correction coefficient (HU = 78.7% in tier2b unit_cost_rates.json). Synthetic demo data - not submittable.

European Fellowship standard duration of 24 months, derived from the intra-EU mobility (Bulgaria -> Hungary) in SYN-SPINE-01. Declared here because the deriver reads project_duration_months from selected_call.json / working_assumptions.json; selected_call.json carries only the call-level max_project_duration_months, which is a call maximum, not a confirmed project fact (the deriver deliberately refuses to use it, per §13.3). Synthetic demo data - not submittable.
